    3) **Customizable Analysis:**  
       - The default view shows quantity and subtotal, but users can adjust filters for customized analysis of sales data.  

    4) **Quick Vendor and Product Comparison:**  
       - View how many products were sold by which vendor, enhancing your sales strategy and vendor relationships.
